arguments.content: P1 pattern: delayed or retried cleanup keyed only by a reusable parent identity can delete state belonging to a later successful operation, even when all operations are serialized. An ownership check is a lifecycle invariant, not merely a concurrency guard. Review cleanup against the unchanged reader across failed operation → replacement completion → delayed cleanup, and preserve removal of the failed operation's own pending state. Existing tests for own-state removal do not establish safety after replacement. Observed in staged cleanup.py versus a7ab15e9fc17243d0f00288ca01907dd06dcdb73; independent code-reviewer found the regression and parent execution reproduced loss of the replacement connection.
